contract: 783A performs four ordered F9E2 pops. The first becomes a 78EE collision probe: mode 80, +4A = caller A5, X/Y 150/262, frame +06 = 912, handler 12646, service +46 = 78EE, extents +1E/+20 = 0038/0008; A4 is then set to it. The next three are return-only objects (mode 80, 12646/12646 from F9E2) with frames 913/914/915 at (X+32,Y), (X,Y+32) and (X+32,Y+32) copied from A4 with word adds. No member writes +08/+0A, +0C/+0D, +0E target or +10 countdown, and the last three keep +4A, so those are inherited; mode 80 never advances the frame. No flags or FF31C0 store; A4/A6 are left on the probe/last member, A5 preserved. Native requires verified inherited fields including +08..+0D and zero unrepresented bytes (+01, +1A..+45), else rejects. Exhaustion enters the never-returning FA1E loop. The rest of level setup, 7910 hits and other F9E2 callers are not reconstructed.
